## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

## Running Code

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

#### Imports

```{r imports}
source('utils.R') # Contains all utility functions to support modelling and analysis, including functions to import/export data, manipulate the MH_posterior objects from the MCMC routines, and generate predictions

library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
```

### Application

#### Figure 7

```{r fig7 setup}
# require(ggridges)
league_acro = 'PL'
season = '2324'
n_run = 1
load(file = paste0("C:/Users/nakaz/OneDrive/Desktop/Research/SBM-CB/CMP_STZ/Data/MH_Results/SAS_FullLeague/",league_acro,"_",season,"_Run",n_run,"_SAS_N_Final.RData"))
MH_object = MH_SAS
t = MH_object$iterations
N = length(MH_object$team_names)

nus = MH_object$nu_post[(t/5):t, ]
nus[nus == 1] = NA

quantiles = apply(nus, 2, function(x) quantile(x, probs = c(0.25, 0.75), na.rm = TRUE))

classify = function(low, high) {
  if (low > 1.1) {
    return("Underdispersed")
  } else if (high < 0.9) {
    return("Overdispersed")
  } else {
    return("Equidispersed")
  }
}

group_colors = c("Underdispersed" = "#D55E00", "Overdispersed" = "#009E73", "Equidispersed" = "gray")

groups = mapply(classify, quantiles[1, ], quantiles[2, ])
names(groups) =  MH_object$team_names

p_z1 = retrieve_nu_sas_summ(MH_SAS$Z_post, MH_SAS$nu_post, (t/5)+1, t)[1,]
names(p_z1) = MH_SAS$team_names

groups[p_z1 < 0.49] = "Equidispersed"

df_long = as.data.frame(nus)
colnames(df_long) = MH_object$team_names

df_long = df_long |>
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "team", values_to = "value") |>
  filter(!is.na(value)) |>
  mutate(group = groups[team]) |>
  mutate(log_value = log(value),
         group = factor(group, levels = c("Underdispersed", "Equidispersed", "Overdispersed"))
        )

team_levels = levels(summary_df$team)
p_z1 = p_z1[team_levels]

df_z1 = data.frame(
  team = factor(names(p_z1), levels = levels(summary_df$team)),
  p_z1 = as.numeric(p_z1)
)

summary_df = df_long |>
  group_by(team, group) |>
  mutate(team = factor(team, levels = levels(summary_df$team))) |>
  arrange(team)
```

```{r fig7 plot}
p_a <- ggplot(summary_df, aes(
  x = log_value,
  y = factor(team, levels = unique(team)), # reverse to match histogram
  fill = group
)) +
  geom_density_ridges(
    scale = 1,             
    rel_min_height = 0.01, 
    alpha = 0.8,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = group_colors) +
  scale_y_discrete(expand = c(0,0)) +   
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "(a)",
    x = expression(log ~ P(nu[i] ~ "|" ~ Z[i] == 1, bold(Y))),
    y = NULL
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "blue", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.7)

offset = 0
p_b <- ggplot(df_z1, aes(
  x = p_z1,
  y = factor(team, levels = (unique(team)))  # match order of rows
)) +
  geom_col(fill = "skyblue3", width = 0.7,
           position = position_nudge(y = -offset)) +   # shift bars down
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", p_z1)),
            hjust = -0.1, size = 3.3,
            position = position_nudge(y = -offset)) +  # shift text
  annotate("segment", x = 0.49, xend = 0.49, y = 0.5, yend = 20.87,
            color = "red3",
            linetype = "dashed",
            linewidth = 0.5
          ) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_y_discrete(expand = c(0,0)) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off", ylim = c(1, 20.87)) +
  labs(
    title = "(b)",
    x = expression(P(Z[i] == 1 ~ "|" ~ bold(Y))),
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(b = 2)),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  )

combined_fig7 = p_a + p_b

ggsave(
  "Plots/Figure7_SlabDensityZ.png",
  plot = combined_fig7,
  width = 1600,
  height = 1200,
  units = "px",
  dpi = 300
)
```

```{r fig8 plot}
library(ggrepel)
p_pois =  ggplot(df_plot_pois, aes(x = att_means, y = def_means, label = team_names)) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = colors), shape = 19, size = 2) + geom_text_repel(size = 3, max.overlaps = 10) +
  scale_color_identity() +
  # scale_y_reverse() +
  # theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10), axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14, face = 'bold')) +
  theme_minimal() + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 'dashed', alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 'dashed', alpha = 0.2) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-1.5, 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-1, 1)) +
  ylab('') + xlab('') +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")) +
  ggtitle('Poisson Model')
p_sas = ggplot(df_plot_sas, aes(x = att_means, y = def_means, label = team_names)) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = colors), shape = 19, size = 2) + geom_text_repel(size = 3, max.overlaps = 10) +
  scale_color_identity() +
  # scale_y_reverse() +
  # theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10), axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14, face = 'bold')) +
  theme_minimal() + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 'dashed', alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 'dashed', alpha = 0.2) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-1.5, 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-1, 1)) +
  ylab('') + xlab('') +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")) +
  ggtitle('CMP-SAS Model')

plots = list()
plots[[1]] = p_pois
plots[[2]] = p_sas

combined_fig8 <- do.call(arrangeGrob, c(plots, nrow = 1, ncol = 2, left = "Mean DEF", bottom = "Mean ATT"))
grid::grid.draw(combined_fig8)

ggsave("figure8_AttDef_PostMeans_Pois_SAS.png", combined_fig8, width = 1600, height = 800, units = "px")
```
#### Table

```{r table setup}
league = 'Premier'
league_acro = 'PL'
season = '2324'

X = read_data(season, league)
X1 = X[[1]]
X2 = X[[2]]

load(file = paste0("C:/Users/nakaz/OneDrive/Desktop/Research/SBM-CB/CMP_STZ/Data/MH_Results/SAS_FullLeague/",league_acro,"_",season,"_Run1_SAS_N_Final.RData"))

sas_pars = retrieve_pars_summ(MH_SAS, burn_in = 0.2)[,1]
t = MH_SAS$iterations
names(sas_pars) = rownames(retrieve_pars_summ(MH_SAS))
retrieve_nu_sas_summ(MH_SAS$Z_post, MH_SAS$nu_post, (t/5), t)[1,]

load(file = paste0("C:/Users/nakaz/OneDrive/Desktop/Research/SBM-CB/CMP_STZ/Data/MH_Results/Pois_FullLeague/",league_acro,"_",season,"_Run1_Pois.RData"))

pois_pars = retrieve_pars_summ(MH_P, burn_in = 0.2)[,1]
names(pois_pars) = rownames(retrieve_pars_summ(MH_P))


df_table = cbind(pois_pars[2:21],
                 pois_pars[22:41],
                 sas_pars[2:21],
                 sas_pars[22:41],
                 log(sas_pars[42:61]),
                 retrieve_nu_sas_summ(MH_SAS$Z_post, MH_SAS$nu_post,  (t/5), t)[1,])

df_sd = cbind(apply(MH_P$att_post[(t/5):t,], 2, sd),
              apply(MH_P$def_post[(t/5):t,], 2, sd),
              apply(MH_SAS$att_post[(t/5):t,], 2, sd),
              apply(MH_SAS$def_post[(t/5):t,], 2, sd),
              apply(log(MH_SAS$nu_post[(t/5):t,]), 2, sd))
df_sd = round(df_sd[order(-df_table[,5]),],3)

rownames(df_table) = MH_SAS$team_names

df_table = cbind(round(df_table[,1:5], 3),
                 round(df_table[,6], 2))

df_sort = df_table[order(-df_table[,5]),]
df_sort_means = df_sort

df_sort_medians = df_sort

df_latex <- df_sort_means %>%
  as.data.frame()

df_latex_sep <- data.frame(
  Mean1 = df_sort_means[,1],
  SD1   = df_sd[,1],
  Mean2 = df_sort_means[,2],
  SD2   = df_sd[,2],
  Mean3 = df_sort_means[,3],
  SD3   = df_sd[,3],
  Mean4 = df_sort_means[,4],
  SD4   = df_sd[,4],
  Mean5 = df_sort_means[,5],
  SD5   = df_sd[,5]
)

kable(
  df_latex_sep,
  format = "latex",
  booktabs = TRUE,
  align = c("l", rep(c("S[table-format=1.3]", "c"), 5)), # mean=S, SD=l
  escape = FALSE
) %>%
  add_header_above(c(" " = 1, "Var1" = 2, "Var2" = 2, "Var3" = 2, "Var4" = 2, "Var5" = 2))

# Keep rownames italicized
rownames(df_latex_sep) <- paste0("\\textit{", rownames(df_latex_sep), "}")


for (j in 1:5) {
  df_latex[[j]] <- sprintf(
    "%.3f {(%.2f)}",
    df_latex[[j]],
    df_sd[, j]
  )
}

rn <- rownames(df_latex)
rownames(df_latex) <- paste0("\\textit{", rn, "}")

# ---- 3. LaTeX table ----
latex_table = kable(
  df_latex,
  format = "latex",
  booktabs = TRUE,                        # cleaner table, no row-by-row hlines
  align = c("l", rep("S", ncol(df_latex) - 1)),# row name column is left-aligned
  escape = FALSE                          # allow italic row names
)
```
